Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: CPI protests lack of allocations to Andhra Pradesh
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Communist Party of India (CPI) is protesting the lack of allocations to Andhra Pradesh in the Union Budget 2026. The CPI is criticizing the budget for not providing sufficient funds to the state, sparking outrage among its members. The protest highlights the perceived neglect of Andhra Pradesh's needs in the federal budget.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Free health tests for 72 lakh under Sanjeevani digital drive: Naidu
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Andhra Pradesh's Chief Minister Naidu has launched the Sanjeevani digital drive, offering free health tests to 72 lakh people. The initiative aims to provide technology-enabled public healthcare, utilizing AI-based advisories and specialist consultations. It targets addressing lifestyle diseases through regular screening across the state.

Major AI Developments.title: RMZ Group to Invest $10 Billion in GCC Park, Data Centre in Andhra Pradesh
Major AI Developments.summary: RMZ Group is investing $10 billion in a GCC Park and data centre in Andhra Pradesh. The projects are expected to create around 100,000 jobs across various sectors, including IT services, data centres, industrial, and logistics. This significant investment aims to boost employment and economic growth in the region.
